title: Drive federation wake and executor recovery from pending work instead of physical history
outcome: Native wake obligations and executor journal recovery select pending work directly, without scanning settled physical history on boot or fallback passes.
acceptance: Native mailbox wake recovery queries pending obligations directly rather than paging all physical obligation history before filtering
Federation executor recovery does not repeatedly restart at the journal's beginning after catching up; settled wake operations do not cost work on later fallback passes
A late pending item behind unrelated retained history is recovered, and restart preserves the same pending identity without duplicate delivery or execution
